meta.description: Talk to Take 3 Agency about casting dancers, SPACTs, models, stand-ins and specialist performers for film, television and commercial productions in the UK.

meta.footerTitle: Tell us what the production needs

hero.heading: Contact
hero.lede: Email, phone, or the enquiry form below. Tell us what the production needs, when and where, and we will come back to you.

details.heading: Reach us

items.label: Email
items.note: The quickest route for a brief, a shortlist request or a rate query.

items.label: Phone
items.note: Office hours, UK time. Useful when a date has moved and the answer cannot wait.

items.label: Instagram
items.note: Recent work, and the fastest way to see who is on the books.

form.intro: The more of this you fill in, the more useful the first reply will be. Anything marked optional can be left blank.

fields.label: Your role
fields.hint: Producer, first AD, coordinator, casting director, and so on.

fields.label: What you are looking for
fields.hint: Roles, numbers, skills or looks. A rough brief is enough to start with.

fields.label: Shoot dates
fields.hint: Approximate is fine if the schedule is not locked.

clients.title: Casting for a production
clients.body: Producers, ADs, coordinators, casting directors and commercial agencies: the form above, the email address or the phone number all reach the same desk.

performers.title: Looking for representation
performers.body: Applications are not taken through this form. Everything for performers, including what we look for and how to apply, sits on one page.
